## Purpose and Deliverables
NanaZip is a Windows file archiver forked from 7-Zip, adding modern Windows integration, extra archive/codecs/hashes, security mitigations, and MSIX deployment. Primary deliverables are MSIX-packaged modern NanaZip, portable/classic variants, command-line and self-extracting executables, and shell integration.
- `NanaZip.slnx`
- `NanaZipPackage/NanaZipPackage.wapproj`
- `NanaZipPackage/Package.appxmanifest`

## Core Archive Engine
`NanaZip.Core` contains the adapted 7-Zip engine: archive handlers, compression/decompression, crypto, streaming, and console/common operation paths. Its interface-based archive and coder registration system is the central boundary between front ends and format implementations.
- `NanaZip.Core/NanaZip.Core.vcxproj`
- `NanaZip.Core/SevenZip/CPP/7zip/Archive/IArchive.h`
- `NanaZip.Core/SevenZip/CPP/7zip/UI/Common/OpenArchive.cpp`

Data flow is generally input files/streams → archive-format handler → registered codecs/crypto → extraction, update, listing, or hash output. SFX projects package this engine with executable front ends.
- `NanaZip.Core/NanaZip.Core.Sfx.Console.vcxproj`
- `NanaZip.Core/NanaZip.Core.Sfx.Windows.vcxproj`

## Extended Codec and Hash Layer
`NanaZip.Codecs` builds NanaZip-specific extensions around vendored native implementations, including Brotli, Zstandard, Fast-LZMA2, LZ4/LZ5, Lizard, filesystem/image handlers, and expanded hash algorithms. Wrapper/registration code adapts these libraries to 7-Zip’s codec contracts.
- `NanaZip.Codecs/NanaZip.Codecs.vcxproj`
- `NanaZip.Codecs/NanaZip.Codecs.cpp`
- `NanaZip.Core/Extensions/ZSCodecs/ZstdRegister.cpp`

This is a native C/C++ boundary: upstream/vendored algorithm sources are isolated under codec subtrees, while NanaZip adapters expose them to the core.
- `NanaZip.Codecs/Zstandard/zstd.h`
- `NanaZip.Codecs/BLAKE3/blake3.c`
- `NanaZip.Codecs/NanaZip.Codecs.Hash.BCryptProvider.cpp`

## Application and Shell Front Ends
The modern application is a C++/WinRT XAML UI layer with pages and controls for archive navigation and operation progress. It bridges modern UI to the native archive engine; classic and modern file-manager/shell projects retain 7-Zip-derived Win32 UI and Explorer integration paths.
- `NanaZip.Modern/App.cpp`
- `NanaZip.Modern/App.xaml`
- `NanaZip.UI.Modern/NanaZip.ShellExtension.cpp`

The modern flavor exposes MSIX file associations, execution aliases, and Explorer context menus; classic is a portable Win32-oriented flavor.
- `NanaZip.UI.Modern/NanaZip.Modern.FileManager.vcxproj`
- `NanaZip.UI.Classic/NanaZip.vcxproj`
- `NanaZip.UI.Modern/SevenZip/CPP/7zip/UI/Explorer/ContextMenu.cpp`

## Windows Compatibility, Policy, and Security Boundary
`K7Base` and `K7User` centralize Windows compatibility behaviors: initialization, modern UI support, dark mode, redirection/detours, policies, and mitigation setup. They protect and adapt native processes before UI/archive work proceeds.
- `K7Base/K7BaseInitialize.cpp`
- `K7Base/K7BaseMitigations.cpp`
- `K7Base/K7BasePolicies.cpp`

The product targets Windows 10 2004+/Windows Server 2022+ on x64 and ARM64. Material platform services include Windows shell/registry APIs, WinRT/XAML, MSIX/Desktop Bridge behavior, and Windows CNG for selected cryptographic hashes.
- `K7User/K7UserDarkMode.cpp`
- `NanaZip.Codecs/NanaZip.Codecs.Hash.BCryptProvider.cpp`

## Build, Versioning, and Distribution
MSBuild orchestrates native projects, package generation, assets, and generated version/resource metadata. Custom .NET tasks update manifests and project resources during builds. GitHub Actions build binaries; releases and Microsoft Store are distribution channels.
- `BuildAllTargets.proj`
- `NanaZip.Build.Tasks/NanaZip.Build.Tasks.csproj`
- `NanaZip.Build.Tasks/RefreshAppxManifestVersion.cs`

Shared project properties control runtime/version identity, while package assets and localized resources are bundled into the MSIX.
- `NanaZip.Project/NanaZip.Project.Runtime.props`
- `NanaZip.Project/NanaZip.Project.Version.props`
- `Assets/PackageAssets`
